name: mycompanion
description: A beginner-friendly desktop AI roleplaying application with observable memory.

scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @mycompanion/macro-engine && npm run build -w @mycompanion/shared
scripts.build:character-card: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mycompanion/character-card
scripts.build: npm run build:character-card && npm run build -w @mycompanion/local-service && npm run build -w @mycompanion/renderer
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @mycompanion/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @mycompanion/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:character-card && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:character-card && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:plugins: npm run build && npm run verify:plugins -w @mycompanion/desktop
scripts.verify:cdn: npm run build -w @mycompanion/desktop && node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop/scripts/verify-cdn.mjs
